purpose: Capability-tag based autonomous routing and reusable mobile H5 hazard reuse; avoids hardcoded trigger words.

keyboard_focus.class: mobile H5/PWA/WebView keyboard changes can move layout, hide CTAs, or break scroll position
keyboard_focus.uaec_bias: ordinary amount/remark/address inputs should keep bottom CTA in its original bottom area when soft keyboard opens; content/form scrolls instead of lifting CTA above keyboard
keyboard_focus.default_gate: classify page model before editing: ordinary form vs short auth vs full-screen composer; avoid global scrollBy/keyboard reserve unless shell-owned

scroll_owner.class: wrong scroll owner causes fixed header/tabbar/CTA occlusion, unreachable fields, or page jump
scroll_owner.default_gate: identify document/body/root/page/content scroll owner and preserve route shell invariants before patching

safe_area_bottom_shell.class: bottom tab/fixed CTA can overlap home indicator or leave white strip in PWA/WebView
safe_area_bottom_shell.current_uaec_evidence: slice3 tabbar safe-area PASS in SSOT evidence for 375/390/414
safe_area_bottom_shell.default_gate: check env(safe-area-inset-bottom) plus fallback; verify nav/CTA rect within viewport

api_backed_blank_section.class: H5 sections can render blank if baseURL/proxy/env differs between dev and preview
api_backed_blank_section.current_uaec_evidence: same-origin /api + preview.proxy verified in SSOT certification report
api_backed_blank_section.default_gate: verify exact opened URL and API route; prove loading/error/empty/data states, not just DOM mount

route_guard_auth_boundary.class: anonymous and authenticated route behavior must not be conflated
route_guard_auth_boundary.default_gate: anonymous smoke can certify redirect boundary only; post-login behavior needs valid session evidence

banner_redirect_token_boundary.class: banner/navigation links can leak token or route third-party URLs incorrectly
banner_redirect_token_boundary.default_gate: current payload runtime smoke + fixture branch coverage; no token-bearing third-party URLs

routing_policy.writeback: progress/evidence/reports/scripts go to ssot_root; product code changes go to primary_repo

authority_boundaries: no push/deploy/credential/device claim without explicit authority and readback
